description_en: Queries the list of broadcast devices
name: QuerySpeechDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view the instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the Project Management console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过项目管理控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en:
The active space of the device. Unit: KB. The value can be any positive number.
The AvailableSpaceScope parameter must be specified at the same time for this parameter to take effect
parameters.help_zh:
设备的可用空间，单位KB，取值为任意正数。
AvailableSpaceScope字段必须同时传入才会生效
parameters.name: available_space

parameters.help_en:
The query condition for the free space of the device.

greater: greater than.
smaller: less than.
equal: equal to.

Example: If AvailableSpace is set to 500 and AvailableSpaceScope is set to smaller, the list of devices whose free space is less than 500 KB is returned
parameters.help_zh:
设备可用空间的查询条件。

greater：大于。
smaller：小于。
equal：等于。

示例：AvailableSpace设置为500，AvailableSpaceScope设置为smaller，则返回可用空间小于500KB的设备列表
parameters.name: available_space_scope

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en: The query condition for the device name. Left-prefix matching is used
parameters.help_zh: 设备名称查询条件，最左前缀匹配
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
